_about: Duties the Whiterun Guard hands its members, read by guard/duty.py. Edit freely. A member's superior (the lowest-ranked leader above them in orgs.json) gives one duty at a time when the member comes to them: only duties whose hours include the current hour, whose rank range fits (min_rank..max_rank, null = no limit) and that differ from the member's last duty. A shift lasts shift_hours from when it is given. The member counts as at their post when a conversation happens at a location whose name contains one of 'where' during the shift (the game reports the location with every conversation). Reporting back before half the shift has passed counts as leaving early. A report with no sign of the member at their post is a false report. merit is what an honest, completed duty adds to the service record (a missed one costs missed_merit, a false report false_merit).

duties.title: stand watch at the main gate
duties.why: Every traveller, caravan and drunk from the Bannered Mare's road comes through the main gate, and the Jarl wants eyes on all of them
duties.instructions: Stand by the main gate, question strangers who look like trouble, and keep the road clear.

duties.title: walk the walls and the Plains District on patrol
duties.why: Giants, bandits and now dragons come from the plains, and the walls are only as good as the guards on them
duties.instructions: Walk the wall walks and the Plains District, look out over the plains, and report anything odd.

duties.title: keep order in the Plains District market
duties.why: Pickpockets work the market stalls and tempers run hot over prices
duties.instructions: Stay near the market stalls, watch for thieves, and calm quarrels before they turn into fights.

duties.title: drill with the other recruits at the barracks
duties.why: A recruit who cannot hold a shield wall is a danger to the guard beside them
duties.instructions: Go to the barracks by the main gate and drill: shield, sword and bow.

duties.title: walk the evening lamp round with the watch
duties.why: When the sun goes down the braziers on the walls and the gate need lighting and tending, and a recruit learns the night streets that way
duties.instructions: Go round with the evening watch: light and tend the braziers on the walls and at the gate, and walk the Plains District until the streets are quiet.

duties.title: keep the night watch on the walls
duties.why: Most trouble comes after dark, and the night watch is the one nobody wants
duties.instructions: Take the night watch on the walls and at the gate until the morning shift relieves you.

duties.title: stand guard in Dragonsreach
duties.why: The Jarl holds court in Dragonsreach, and petitioners, envoys and the odd madman come before him every day
duties.instructions: Stand your post in the great hall of Dragonsreach and keep the peace before the Jarl's throne.

_about_incidents: Incidents (G2d, guard/incident.py): trouble the guard is sent to deal with. Each game day every kind is rolled once (chance); at most one of each kind is open. The member's superior gives an open incident as a duty ahead of routine duties, at any hour, if the member's rank is at least min_rank. need 'seen' = done by being at a place in 'where' (a conversation there); need 'fight' = done only by fighting there. Reporting back after that closes it (outcome arrested / cleared, which gossip carries); merit as for duties. It goes cold after lasts_days if nobody takes it. {complainant} and {camp} are filled from the lists.

incidents.title: catch the cutpurse working the Plains District market
incidents.why: {complainant} had a purse snatched in the market and wants the thief caught
incidents.instructions: Go to the market, ask the stallholders and passers-by what they saw, find the thief and bring them in.
culprits: a Dunmer sellsword named Teris Arvel
a Nord farmhand named Ulgar the Lean

incidents.title: break up the brawl at the Bannered Mare
incidents.why: Hulda sent word that drinkers at the Bannered Mare have come to blows
incidents.instructions: Get to the Bannered Mare, separate the brawlers, and take the one who started it to the cells.
culprits: a drunk caravan guard named Bjorn Ale-Belly
a farmhand from the Battle-Born fields named Gerdvald
a sellsword named Kraldar the Loud

incidents.title: drive off the bandits waylaying travellers on the road to Riverwood
incidents.why: Travellers coming up from Riverwood say bandits are stopping carts near the river and taking their coin
incidents.instructions: Ride or walk the road towards Riverwood, find the bandits and drive them off or put them down. Come back when it is done.

incidents.title: clear out the bandits at {camp}
incidents.why: The bandits holed up at {camp} have been raiding farms on the plains, and the Jarl wants them gone
incidents.instructions: Take whoever you can trust, go to {camp} and clear the bandits out. Come back and report when it is done.

encounters._about: G2e shift encounters (guard/encounter.py). Each routine duty has watch windows at these fractions of the shift. While nothing has happened yet a window comes up with first_chance (by window), after that with extra_chance: with 0.5/0.8/0.9 about 1 shift in 100 has nothing at all. approach_share of windows bring someone over (if nobody suitable is near, the member notices one of the observations instead). Categories are weighted by weight, x night between 22 and 5, x the first matching place word, x when_incident while trouble is open; min_rank makes a category rare below that rank. who: anyone (not a guard), guard (a fellow guard), superior (the member's own superior, inspecting), returning (someone who came over in the last two weeks). Placeholders: {player} is not used; {post}, {superior}, {incident}, {last}, {hold}, {guard}. refer = usually a matter for the superior. Each answered encounter adds merit_each merit (at most merit_cap a shift). npc_cooldown_days: the game skips someone who came over this recently.

categories.label: A civilian's question
reasons: you want directions (to a shop, a house, the road to Riverwood or Rorikstead) and a guard should know
you have lost something (a purse, a ring, a goat) and want the guard to keep an eye out for it
you want to know whether the roads out of {hold} are safe right now
you heard a rumour and want a guard to tell you whether it is true
you want to complain about a noisy or unpleasant neighbour

categories.label: A merchant's dispute
reasons: a customer will not pay what they owe you, or a trader cheated you, and you want the guard to settle it
you suspect a stall is selling stolen or spoiled goods
you want a guard to keep an eye on your stall or cart for a while
two traders are quarrelling over who may set up where, and you want it sorted

categories.label: A political request
reasons: you want a message carried to the Jarl's steward and think a guard can see it gets there
you want the guard to hear your complaint about the Jarl's handling of the war
you want the guard's help to bring a petition before the Jarl's court

categories.label: A report of wrongdoing
reasons: you saw something to do with the recent trouble ({incident}) and want to tell a guard
someone has been loitering near your home and you want the guard to look into it
a few coins or a basket went missing today and you want to report it

categories.label: Someone needs help
reasons: someone nearby has been hurt or taken ill (a fall, a fever, a drunk who hit their head) and you want the guard's help getting them to Arcadia or the Temple of Kynareth

categories.label: An odd encounter
reasons: you are new in {hold} and looking for someone who does not seem to be here
you have had a few drinks and want to share your opinion of the guard
you saw something strange in the sky or on the plains and want to know if the guard has heard of it
you lost a bet and want a guard to settle a silly argument

categories.label: Word from a fellow guard
reasons: you bring word from {superior}: keep a sharp eye out at the post, there has been talk of trouble
you are passing on the watchword for tonight and checking {post} is covered
you want to warn a fellow guard about a troublemaker you saw earlier
you are on your rounds and stop to compare notes about the shift

categories.label: An inspection
reasons: you are inspecting your subordinate at their post: their kit, their alertness, and whether they know their orders for the duty to {post}
you are checking that the duty to {post} is being done properly and want a quick report

categories.label: A follow-up
reasons: you are coming back about what you raised with this guard last time ({last})

observations.text: A cart has lost a wheel near the gate and is blocking half the road.
The bar on the main gate is cracked and will need replacing.
A stall's awning was cut through in the night.
A lamp along the walls has gone out.
Two drunks argued outside the Bannered Mare and went their separate ways.
A courier passed through the gate heading for Dragonsreach.
A stray dog keeps nosing around the market stalls.
Fresh footprints in the mud lead from the wall towards the river.
Your shield strap is fraying; your kit needs a look at Warmaiden's.
A merchant's scales look off; customers may be short-changed.
Smoke from a chimney in the Plains District looked heavy for a while, then settled.
A pair of travellers asked about work at the stables and moved on.
Someone has been sleeping rough behind the Drunken Huntsman.
A Khajiit caravan's people were turned away at the gate again and grumbled about it.

training._about: G2g recruit training (guard/training.py). A member of a rank in for_ranks gets these steps from their superior one at a time, in order, before routine duties and incidents, with no rest needed between steps. need: seen (be at the place, report after half the step's hours), fight (a sparring bout: the game's fight record at the place), escort (seen at the place with a fellow guard in the conversation), quiz (the superior asks the questions below there and then; an answer with any of a question's words counts right; pass_right right answers pass, fail_wrong wrong ones fail the attempt without a reprimand). Each step adds its merit; all done adds complete_merit and, with no reprimand, passes probation early (early_probation).

steps.title: drill with spear and shield in the barracks yard
steps.why: A recruit who cannot hold a shield wall is a danger to the guards beside them
steps.instructions: Go to the barracks and drill until the drill master is satisfied: stance, shield, spear, and keeping your place in line.

steps.title: go a sparring bout with fists against a fellow guard
steps.why: Most trouble a guard meets is a drunk or a brawler, and it is settled with fists, not steel
steps.instructions: Ask a fellow guard for a bout, fists only, and fight it out. Win or lose, you learn.

steps.title: answer questions on Whiterun's law and the guard's orders
steps.why: A guard who does not know the law cannot enforce it
steps.instructions: Answer the Commander's questions on the law and on standing orders.

steps.title: walk a patrol through the city beside a senior guard
steps.why: The streets are learned on foot, beside someone who knows them
steps.instructions: Find a senior guard and walk their round with them, through the Plains District and up to the Wind District.

questions.ask: What do you do with someone caught stealing from a stall?
questions.answer: stop them, get the goods back to the owner, and arrest them or have them pay a fine

questions.ask: Who do you take your orders from and report to?
questions.answer: the Commander of the Guard, Caius, and above him the Housecarl and the Jarl

questions.ask: A merchant offers you coin to look the other way. What do you do?
questions.answer: refuse it and report the offer; taking it is a crime

questions.ask: What is the penalty for murder in Whiterun?
questions.answer: death, or prison for life if the Jarl shows mercy

questions.ask: When may a guard draw steel on a citizen?
questions.answer: only when someone draws a weapon or attacks; words alone are no reason

questions.ask: The bell rings for an attack on the walls. Where do you go?
questions.answer: to your post on the walls or at the gate, ready to defend

arrest._note: G2f arrests (livingworld/guard/arrest.py). Chances are shares of 1; days are game days.
